verdict.rationale: Kit's MCP/API expose segments as an entity (kit-docs-29) and broadcasts can target by segment id (kit-docs-2), and the MCP overview shows NL prompts turning into real account actions like drafting broadcasts (kit-docs-5), suggesting a programmatic path exists for an agent to work with audience segmentation. However, there is no documented endpoint or example specifically showing an agent creating/defining a new segment from a plain-language audience description. Missing for 10: a documented 'create segment' API/MCP action, and a concrete NL-to-segment example analogous to the broadcast example.
